Authenticated PAM proof end-to-end: statics -> python3+ctypes libpam login on service greetd -> daemon logs 'Received unlock request' in secrets.log. Transport graveyard diagnosed on live VMs: (1) ssh -L unix forward dead — stock Alpine sshd AllowTcpForwarding no denies ALL local forwards incl. streamlocal + guest.Output CombinedOutput polluted socket path with known_hosts warning; (2) greetd-IPC second start_session dead — greetd 0.10 = ONE session, second session kills autologin c1 -> turnstile tears user dinit down (STOPPD storm) + pam_oo7 delivery thread loses race; (3) FINAL = direct PAM chain over plain exec SSH, autologin + daemon untouched. Second root cause: ctypes RTLD_LOCAL — pam_oo7.so has no DT_NEEDED libpam.so.0 -> musl dlopen fails -> PAM silently skips optional module rc=0; fix mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL (one line). Source-verified 0.6.0: daemon log = tracing::info! (RUST_LOG=info suffices); wire = zvariant D-Bus + u32 LE not JSON; secrets.log = only observable surface; start_daemon fallback = our recovery wrapper (supervision intact). Zero product changes this round. Also: aports CI fix b3970c1 (mirror.gcr.io), oo7-user-dinit r1, installer RUST_LOG=info under enableDebug. OPEN ROUND: D-Bus activation -> dinit services (ADR-010, Soluzione A). User directive: nothing dbus-activatable may run unsupervised; every activation starts a dinit unit (system bus -> system dinit, session bus -> turnstile user dinit). R1 naming: unit = canonical well-known bus name (+.user for user units; aliases map to same unit). R2 activation: effective .service Exec = /usr/libexec/feralos/dbus-activate <unit> -- <upstream exec>; overrides in /etc/dbus-1/system-services (system, highest precedence) and /usr/local/share/dbus-1/services (session, before /usr/share); dbus-daemon waits for the daemon to claim the name (forking activation). Shim forwards activation env to dinit with ONE dinitctl setenv (names; values from its env), then dinitctl start (waits), exits; OpenRC system-bus fallback = exec upstream when no system dinit; session bus always user dinit. Activation env NOT skipped. Design docs: docs/architecture/dbus-activation.md + ADR-010. ADR-010: D-Bus activation routes through dinit services. Mechanism chosen = shim + precedence service-file overrides (no dbus fork): Exec=/usr/libexec/feralos/dbus-activate <unit> -- <upstream exec>; unit name = canonical bus name (+.user for user units); activation env forwarded with one dinitctl setenv call; OpenRC system-bus falls back to upstream exec; session bus always turnstile user dinit. Chimera's dinit-dbus Activator/routing is not implemented upstream (verified); Artix routes nothing; systemd starts a unit per bus (system vs user).

D-Bus activation → dinit (ADR-010) CLOSED: every dbus-activatable daemon starts a dinit unit via the /usr/libexec/feralos/dbus-activate shim (R1: unit = canonical well-known bus name +.user; R2: effective .service Exec = shim <unit> -- <upstream exec>). System overrides ship in /usr/share/feralos/dbus-system-services and are materialized at boot by the new dbus-services-setup service (dinit unit + OpenRC initd, before dbus) into /usr/local/share/dbus-1/system-services; session overrides ship in /usr/share/feralos/dbus-services and are materialized at login into $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dbus-1/services. dbus 1.16.2 system-bus activation gate: the setuid dbus-daemon-launch-helper uses the TRIVIAL config parser — it resolves service names ONLY against the standard dirs (/usr/local/share first, then /usr/share, DBUS_DATADIR, /lib). /etc/dbus-1/system-services and /run/dbus-1/system-services are loaded by the daemon (visible in ListActivatableNames) but NEVER searched by the helper: activation raw-spawns the /usr/share twin or fails Spawn.ServiceNotFound. System-bus override mechanism must materialize into /usr/local/share/dbus-1/system-services (live-proven).
